evals.prompt: Run a weekend scanner for poor man's covered call candidates.
evals.expected_output: A ranked table of PMCC candidates from the built-in universe. Each candidate shows a deep-ITM LEAP call (>=0.80 delta, long-dated) as the long leg and a modeled ~30-delta short call, plus net debit, extrinsic, and a recovery/yield ratio used for ranking. Should note how many tickers were skipped.

assertions.name: ranked_table_present
assertions.description: Response contains a ranked list/table of PMCC candidates across multiple tickers

assertions.name: has_leap_leg
assertions.description: Each candidate shows a deep-ITM long-dated LEAP call with ~0.80+ delta as the long leg

assertions.name: has_short_leg
assertions.description: Each candidate shows a modeled short call (strike, delta, credit) to sell against the LEAP

assertions.name: has_ranking_metric
assertions.description: Candidates are ranked by a PMCC yield/recovery metric (short-call income vs LEAP extrinsic)

assertions.name: reports_skipped
assertions.description: Response mentions how many tickers were skipped or why, rather than silently dropping them

evals.prompt: Scan AAPL, NVDA, and MSFT for PMCC setups. I want at least 0.85 delta on the LEAP.
evals.expected_output: Scans only the three named tickers using a 0.85 LEAP delta target instead of the 0.80 default. Returns candidates (or skip reasons) for each, with a risk checklist covering earnings and dividend/early-assignment risk on the short call.

assertions.name: respects_ticker_list
assertions.description: Only AAPL, NVDA, MSFT are scanned, not the full universe

assertions.name: respects_delta_override
assertions.description: Uses 0.85 LEAP delta target rather than the default 0.80

assertions.name: has_risk_checklist
assertions.description: Response includes a risk checklist covering at least earnings and dividend/early-assignment risk
